name: Oracle (a model handed the true future)
detail: Scores ≈ perfect: CRPS ≈ 0, Brier 0, 80% coverage 1. A truth shifted by 30 minutes scores strictly worse. Run on synthetic data, Docker workers included.

name: Known answers
detail: Constant, last-value and straight-line models reproduce hand-computed scores on a tiny synthetic world.

name: Determinism
detail: Same seed gives byte-identical score rows across two runs, across in-process vs subprocess workers, and for any --jobs N.

name: Leak probes
detail: Models that try every way to see the future (files, environment, stack, history internals, the child cache, state carried between test cases, network, timing) gain nothing over a constant forecast inside Docker workers. On host workers a probe CAN read snapshot files, so host workers run trusted models only; every agent model is scored in Docker.

name: Leak control
detail: With the null-slot scrub switched off, the probe does see hidden values, so the probe is real.

name: Synthetic recovery
detail: On synthetic data, a model built from the true generating process beats every simple model (5-hour CRPS 0.27 vs about 4.3).

name: Calibration sanity
detail: Paths drawn from the true process give 80% coverage of about 0.82 and a roughly flat PIT.

name: Snapshot checks (frozen-2026-10-24)
detail: All 9 gates: store matches raw transcripts exactly, store matches the archive, Claude Code's own counters match, readings, cycles, prices, point-in-time slicing, byte-identical rebuild, leak scan.

name: Docker isolation
detail: A probe model inside a scoring container finds no ARENA_HOME, no snapshot, no data file anywhere and no network; the same probe on the host does read the snapshot.

name: Replay parity with the app
detail: The Python port of the shipping engine reproduces 1,278 of 1,278 predictions the current app recorded (largest gap 0.00002 points), and 97.8% of 28,870 including older engine versions.

name: Leaks found and closed by the self-tests
detail: 1) masked columns still carried their hidden values in the Arrow buffer under null slots (fixed: every served table is rebuilt; the as-of assertion refuses a null slot with a value). 2) Scoring between checkpoints made run time reveal how many future readings existed (fixed: scoring waits until the model's process has closed).
